title: CI: scan-worker image build runs out of runner disk (intermittent)
body:
**What fails.** `images / image (scan-worker)` runs out of disk on the GitHub-hosted runner while building the scan-worker image:

```
ERROR: failed to build: failed to solve: ResourceExhausted: write /var/lib/buildkit/runc-overlayfs/content/ingest/…/ref: no space left on device
```

**Where.**
- PR #40 head 20c26a3: run 43017595486, job 130513213284. The job ran for 16 minutes, then failed.
- The same job failed for the same reason on feature/ci-pipelines eb4a6fd (run 42984519034: "No space left on device" in the runner's diag log).
- It passed on 6c6d442 (run 42988303142).

So the build sits right at the runner's disk limit and fails intermittently. It is not caused by the PR's code.

**Fix (CI config, so it needs the `security-config-reviewed` label).**
- Before the scan-worker build, free runner disk by removing the preinstalled toolchains the job does not use (`/usr/share/dotnet`, `/usr/local/lib/android`, `/opt/ghc`, `/opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL`, `docker image prune -af`). That frees roughly 20–30 GB.
- Alternatively, slim the scan-worker image with a multi-stage build, so the Go/tool build layers are not kept.
- Print `df -h` before and after, so the margin is visible in the log.

**Acceptance.** Three consecutive scan-worker image builds pass, with at least 10 GB free at the end of the build (shown in the log).
